subject: Mobile Development
title: AI-Driven Personalized Interfaces
description: A fast breakdown of AI-Driven Personalized Interfaces for builders.

hook.text: What if every user saw a different version of the app, optimized just for them?

buildup.text: AI can rearrange menus, suggest actions, and show content based on individual usage patterns.

discovery.text: Spotify's Discover Weekly and Netflix's home screen are already AI-personalized interfaces.

twist.text: Personalization creates filter bubbles. Users see only what algorithms think they want.

climax.text: AI-driven design promises relevance but risks trapping users in increasingly narrow experiences.

punchline.text: Personalized for you — or a cage built by data.

quiz.question: What risk does AI-driven personalization create?
options: Filter bubbles that limit what users discover
